shared_elements: shallow incised linear ornament on a rounded three-dimensional form
sets of parallel curved or straight lines forming a band
museum display (mount or plinth) with blurred interior background
justification: Both are weathered, coarse-grained stone sculptures whose decoration consists of shallow incised lines organised into bands, with A's lattice of crossing lines loosely echoing the panel of parallel and crossing incisions on the upper back of B. The decisive differences are scale and completeness: A is a small detached fragment photographed close up with a single dense hatched panel, while B is a monumental figural monolith whose incisions include distinct rings, hooked forms and arm-like curves distributed over a whole body.
